description: Ministry of Land & Parliamentary Reforms - Order under Land Acquisition Act to Appointment  Mr. D. B. Wickramarasinghe as acquiring officer of Galle, Four Gravets D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily concerns land acquisition matters. It specifically appoints an officer for land acquisition duties related to development projects (Moragoda Ela, Moda Ela, Kepoo Ela and cross canals development projects) under the Land Acquisition Act. While it mentions a government minister and makes an appointment, the core subject matter is land acquisition and property matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). The appointment is specifically for land-related duties rather than general government personnel changes.
